decision.rationale: I recommend declining this dispute. The cardholder opened it in time: TXN-007896 posted on 2026-09-16 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-29, which is 43 days later and within the 120-day limit (time-limits). The posted amount is 2613 cents (26.13 EUR). The authorised amount on AUTH-008105 is 2376 cents (23.76 EUR). The cardholder says the bill was 23.76 EUR, but no receipt is attached, so that amount is only their claim. MER-000029 (Stonecrest Brasserie) is a RESTAURANT. The posted amount is 237 cents above the authorised amount. 20% of the authorised amount is 475.2 cents, so the difference is within the tip tolerance. Under amount-restaurant-tip, that counts as an agreed tip, not an amount mismatch.

proposed_actions.reason: You paid by chip and PIN for 23.76 EUR, and 26.13 EUR was charged. Restaurants may charge a tip of up to 20% above the authorised amount. The extra 2.37 EUR is within that limit, so it is treated as an agreed tip, not a billing error.
